label: Ryde advance no-show · public policy snapshot

clauses.title: Rydr safeguard: Pickup zone determination
clauses.text: Pickup radius is 50 metres. Let d be the Haversine distance between a stationary driver sample and the pickup point, and a the reported accuracy radius: inside if d + a <= 50, outside if d - a > 50, otherwise indeterminate. A location accuracy radius must be present for an automatic quality determination. This is a conservative engineering rule, not a statistical guarantee of location accuracy.

clauses.title: Rydr safeguard: Arrival requires corroborating presence evidence
clauses.text: An arrival flag alone is insufficient. Require usable stationary GPS samples supporting presence, no contrary off-zone observation, and no excessive sampling gap. The demo continuity limit is 180 seconds; neither location nor stops are interpolated across larger gaps as fact.

clauses.title: Published waiting clock
clauses.text: For this snapshot example, use the recorded driver “I’m Here” action. For advance pickup before the scheduled time, the clock is unclear and requires review.

clauses.title: Ryde no-show cancellation condition
clauses.text: A driver no-show cancellation after more than three minutes of waiting can incur a rider cancellation charge of S$6.61. This differs from the S$5 waiting charge when the rider boards and the trip completes.

clauses.title: Rydr safeguard: Fee eligibility prerequisites
clauses.text: Rydr checks location, elapsed waiting, cancellation reason and trip completion before proposing a result. Missing contact evidence prompts review; it does not establish an official refund entitlement.

clauses.title: Rydr safeguard: Outcomes for no-show disputes
clauses.text: Rydr proposes a simulated refund when verified evidence contradicts the no-show condition. Uncertain evidence or policy scope requires human review. Ryde retains discretion over real refunds.

clauses.title: Rydr safeguard: What may not be inferred
clauses.text: Rider absence is never deduced merely from no replies; that supports only a lack of observed response. Account history and ratings cannot change fee eligibility or which party wins.

clauses.title: Rydr safeguard: Evidence quality score is heuristic
clauses.text: The prototype score is completeness plus source traceability plus consistency plus category-specific measurement quality, divided by 100. It is not a calibrated probability of being correct.

clauses.title: Rydr safeguard: High-value review threshold
clauses.text: A disputed amount above 5000 cents routes to human review. Thresholds are prototype configuration, not calibrated production values.

clauses.title: Contact before cancellation
clauses.text: Ryde advises trying in-app chat or a call when the rider is unreachable before considering cancellation.

clauses.title: Advance booking scope
clauses.text: Advance rider cancellations more than fifteen minutes before pickup are uncharged. A late match has a three-minute grace period. Driver no-show cancellation requires more than three minutes waiting.

applicability: Public sources retrieved 2 Oct 2026. Publication effective dates are not established. This is a synthetic policy-snapshot demonstration, not confirmation of the policy in force for an older real trip.
